en.headline: Private home prices fall 0.46 per cent in July after 13-month rise
en.dek: The Rating and Valuation Department’s index slipped to 321.5, while the rental index hit a record 207.4 after a further monthly gain.
body: The Rating and Valuation Department’s private domestic price index stood at 321.5 in July, down 0.46 per cent from June, ending 13 consecutive months of increases, according to figures reported on Thursday. Prices were still about 7.3 per cent higher over the first seven months of 2026 and about 11.6 per cent higher than a year earlier.

Compared with the record 398.1 points in September 2021, the July index remained about 19.2 per cent lower. Smaller and mid-sized flats in classes A to C fell about 0.46 per cent on the month, while larger class D and E units were down about 0.31 per cent. Class B flats, of 431 to 752 square feet saleable area, recorded the steepest monthly drop among the size bands, at 0.57 per cent. The largest class E units were unchanged.

Rents continued to climb. The rental index reached 207.4, up 0.8 per cent from June and a fresh high, extending a run of monthly increases. The index was about 3.4 per cent higher over the first seven months of the year.

zh.headline: 7月私樓售價指數跌0.46% 連升13個月後轉跌
zh.dek: 差飼物業估價署數字顯示指數報321.5點，今年首七個月仍累升約7.3%；租金指數再創新高。
body: 差飼物業估價署公布，2026年7月私人住宅售價指數報321.5點，按月下跌0.46%，終止連續13個月升勢。今年首七個月樓價仍累升約7.3%，按年則升約11.6%。
與2021年9月歷史高位398.1點比較，7月指數仍低約19.2%。中小型單位（A至C類）按月跌約0.46%，大型單位（D、E類）跌約0.31%。實用面積431至752平方呎的B類單位按月跌0.57%，跌幅最大；1,722平方呎或以上的E類單位則持平。
租金方面，7月租金指數報207.4點，按月升0.8%，再創歷史新高，連升數月。今年首七個月租金指數累升約3.4%。
